entities.name: Table T17 – GenAIDataCenter Global GenAI Power Consumption and Growth Rates
entities.brief: Global GenAI power use and growth projections (2023-2028)
entities.description: Highlights global GenAI power consumption rising from 29 TWh to 686 TWh by 2028, with growth rate slowing from 176% to 43%, underscoring infrastructure demands.

properties.key_insight: Global GenAI power consumption projected to rise from 29 TWh in 2023 to 686 TWh by 2028, while growth rate decelerates from 176% to 43%.

entities.name: Table T18 – GenAIDataCenter US GenAI Power Consumption and Growth Rates
entities.brief: US GenAI power use and growth projections (2023-2028)
entities.description: Shows US GenAI power consumption increasing from 10 TWh to 370 TWh by 2028, with growth rate peaking at 440% then decelerating to 45%, indicating strong domestic AI infrastructure demand.

properties.key_insight: US GenAI power consumption forecast to increase from 10 TWh in 2023 to 370 TWh by 2028, with growth rate peaking near 440% in 2024 then falling to around 45% by 2028.

entities.name: Table T19 – GenAIDataCenter Global Data Center Capex by Region and Workload
entities.brief: Global data center capex allocation by region and hardware/build (2025-2028)
entities.description: Breaks down $2.89 trillion of global data center investment into $1.296 trillion build costs and $1.594 trillion hardware costs, highlighting US build spend of $754 billion and AI hardware share of $1.419 trillion.

properties.table_content:
| Category | Sub-category | Amount ($bn) | Cost per MW |
|---|---|---|---|
| Total Capex 2025-2028 | | $2,890 | N/A |
| Global Build Costs | Total | $1,296 | N/A |
| Global Build Costs | US | $754 | ~$11mm/MW |
| Global Build Costs | APAC | $101 | ~$8mm/MW |
| Global Build Costs | Europe | $117 | ~$12mm/MW |
| Global Build Costs | ROW | $324 | ~$10mm/MW |
| Total Hardware Costs | Total | $1,594 | N/A |
| Total Hardware Costs | AI Hardware | $1,419 | ~$16.5mm/MW |
| Total Hardware Costs | non-AI Hardware | $175 | ~$6.5mm/MW |
properties.key_insight: Global data center capex of $2.89 trillion for 2025-2028 split into $1.296 trillion build costs and $1.594 trillion hardware costs, with US build costs at $754 billion and AI hardware costs at $1.419 trillion.
